hero.title: Amazon label and invoice splitter
hero.subtitle: Split Amazon bulk label and invoice PDFs into a labels-only file for thermal printing.

intro: Upload the combined shipment PDF from Seller Central. The tool keeps label pages and drops invoice pages. Processing stays in your browser.

tips.title: Page pattern
tips.body: Amazon bulk PDFs usually alternate label then invoice. Choose the pattern that matches your export.

tips.title: Thermal printers
tips.body: Send the labels-only PDF to your 4x6 thermal printer.

tips.title: Privacy
tips.body: Files are not uploaded to a server.
